returns [] without error; ValueError for the bad mode

own_tests.input: Real fastembed models on CPU over knowledge/index (2258 chunks), default rerank: 'early blight on tomato leaves' (crop=tomato), 'apple scab control' (apple), off-topic 'how to cook pasta carbonara' (tomato), unknown crop 'dragonfruit', pear + bm25 'fire blight', apple + disease filter
own_tests.result: Relevant queries return crop-correct passages with source and page. Off-topic query returns [] with rerank on. Unknown crop returns [] (no relevant general). No errors.

notes: (1) With rerank=False and real bge-small, the default min_score 0.3 does not filter anything: the off-topic pasta query scored 0.76-0.78 on tomato passages. Cosine scores from this model are compressed, so the threshold only works with the cross-encoder (the default). A later tuning task (#40/#43) should calibrate thresholds per mode. (2) Passage vectors are not persisted: the first dense/hybrid search embeds all 2258 chunks on CPU, and each new Retriever repeats it (the 12-search script took about 187 s including model download). Consider caching before serving. (3) Hybrid mixes a raw cosine with max-normalised BM25, so the weighting is a heuristic. (4) The test that the query stays separate from conversation text is only a documented contract. (5) The tmp tests are in the git-ignored orchestration/evidence/tmp-T6.2/.
